title: Social Housing Loans: Eligibility, 80% Loan Limit and Repayment Calculation
desc: Social housing loans from the Vietnam Bank for Social Policies: eligibility, the 80% maximum, interest rate, 25-year term, and a monthly payment example.
summary: Eligibility, loan amount, interest rate and term of preferential social housing loans under Decree 100/2024/ND-CP (as amended), with an example for assessing repayment ability.
body: p

Social housing is a suitable choice for many middle- and low-income families. Besides a sale price lower than commercial housing, buyers may also receive a preferential State loan (Clause 5, Article 77 of the Housing Law). This article summarizes the loan conditions and how to assess your repayment ability yourself.
h2
1. Who can get a preferential loan to buy social housing?
p

First, you must be an eligible person and meet the housing and income conditions to buy social housing (Article 78 of the Housing Law) – see Conditions for buying social housing. To borrow from the Vietnam Bank for Social Policies, under Clause 1, Article 48 of Decree 100/2024/ND-CP, the borrower must meet these conditions:
ol
Have a source of income and the ability to repay as committed to the Vietnam Bank for Social Policies;
Have a loan application to buy or lease-purchase social housing;
Have a contract to buy or lease-purchase social housing with the investor;
Secure the loan with the property formed from the loan; the bank, the investor and the borrower sign a tripartite contract providing for the management and handling of the collateral.
h2
2. How much can you borrow, at what rate, for how long?
ul
Loan amount: up to 80% of the contract value for buying or lease-purchasing the home (Point a, Clause 3, Article 48).

Interest rate: 5.4% per year; interest on overdue debt equals 130% of the lending rate (Clause 4, Article 48, as amended by Decree 261/2025/ND-CP). When a change is needed, the Prime Minister considers and decides.
Term: agreed between the bank and the customer, suited to repayment ability, up to 25 years from the first disbursement date (Clause 5, Article 48).
A person (or a household) eligible for several preferential loan policies may only apply the single highest-level policy (Article 46).
h2
3. Example: calculating the monthly payment
p
Assume a social housing unit priced at VND 900 million. The buyer contributes VND 180 million (20%) and borrows VND 720 million (80%) at 5.4% per year, with level payments:
ul
25-year loan: payments of about VND 4.38 million per month.
20-year loan: payments of about VND 4.91 million per month.
If payments are late, the overdue debt bears interest of 130% × 5.4% = 7.02% per year.
p

Under the prudent rule (debt payments not exceeding 30–40% of stable income), a payment of VND 4.4–4.9 million suits a family with a stable income of roughly VND 12–16 million per month or more. Besides loan payments, remember to include apartment building management and operation fees, electricity and water, and the cost of interior fit-out.
h2
4. Borrowing to build or repair your own house
p

Some eligible persons may also receive a preferential loan to build a new home or renovate and repair their own: up to 70% of the estimated cost or capital-use plan, not exceeding VND 1 billion and not exceeding 70% of the value of the collateral (Point b, Clause 3, Article 48). The file requires the land use right certificate, a cost-pricing plan, and a construction permit if one is required (Clause 2, Article 48).
h2
5. Notes to avoid losing your rights
ul
Prepare the own-funds portion (at least 20% of the contract value) and a reserve.
Pay advances to the investor on the contract schedule; obtain all documents.
Social housing is collateral for the loan; repay on time to avoid overdue interest and enforcement against the property.
note

This article is for reference only and is not financial advice. Decree 100/2024/ND-CP is partially no longer in force; apart from Decrees 261/2025/ND-CP and 136/2026/ND-CP, our library does not yet have Decree 54/2026/ND-CP (which also amends Decree 100) – the interest rate and conditions may have changed. Ask the Vietnam Bank for Social Policies at the project's location before registering.
